name: Kano Shiina
source:
Romantic Stance: Has given up on her love
Emotion towards protagonist: Thinks "he is like a dog"

Third year high school student. Protagonist's senpai. Student Council President, who is extremely popular and has mastered the "carrot and stick" policy.

Has outstanding feminity and efficient in working in fields.  Loves children and is very good at taking care of others.

In backlash of being brought up by a strict father, likes to do whatever she wants, in private.

"Yes yes, you can play as much as you want later, but for the time being, stop doing such strange stuff."

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=903610]Getchu[/url]]
